description:
*“Don’t you want to know why I kept chasing after you like my life depended on it?”*

Wait… what the hell? Why is this guy here?!

Veteran RPG gamer Choi Rim (in-game nickname: Cream) is constantly stressed by a newbie sniper, Pie, who doggedly pursues him to death. After taking a break from the game for a while, Cream logs back in for just a moment—only to receive a message from someone claiming to be Pie, asking to meet in real life. That’s when Cream decides to settle things offline.
